title: Eel Bridge RPC API Contract for Native Desktop File Dialogs
description: Defines Eel exposed RPC endpoints for native OS file dialog operations.

endpoints.name: open_file_dialog
endpoints.description: Opens a native OS file picker dialog filtered for Excel .xlsx files.

file_path.description: Selected absolute file path or null if cancelled

endpoints.name: save_file_dialog
endpoints.description: Opens a native OS save file dialog for choosing destination directory and filename.

file_path.description: Chosen destination file path or null if cancelled
